full_page.content:
1935, May 1
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap. (to Mr. Owen Casey) May 1 Fr. Solanus with H.J. Macey and Sister. H.J. had left school, for some weeks blind. Was brought to Monastery and enrolled in Ser. Mass Assoc'n. reading on way home (Jan 2 - '34) : went back to school next day.
- - Had been baptized with their father and two younger - Dec. 24th.
Now received Ist Holy Communion. Thanks be to God for this and many similar favors reported.
Fr. Solanus O.M.Cap.
You see Dear Owen, I'm getting to look like an old man. 20 years since you and I met, have made quite a change; but O! --- what will 20 yrs. more bring? Let us get ready as J. T. got ready ... B. Fr. Sol.
(above written on back of a photo of two children in First Communion dress with Fr. Solanus and sent to his brother, Owen Casey in Seattle, Wash. C. 1935)
